### The Promise Kept
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/promise-kept
Passage: Genesis 46:8-25
Points:
- Abraham and Isaac saw only the earliest stages of God's covenant promise, each fathering just one son of promise.
- Jacob experienced a fuller realization of that promise, living to see twelve sons and many grandchildren.
- The listing of Jacob's descendants highlights God's ongoing work in multiplying Abraham's family as promised.
- Even with a growing household, Jacob had to trust God's faithfulness for promises that would extend beyond his lifetime.
- Modern Christians can take courage seeing God's promises fulfilled globally as people from every nation follow Christ.

### Seventy In Egypt
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/seventy-egypt
Passage: Genesis 46:26-27
Points:
- God's covenant with Abraham foretold that his offspring would dwell and suffer in a foreign nation before being delivered.
- The sixty-six descendants refer to the direct family members who traveled together with Jacob into Egypt.
- The total of seventy people, including Jacob, Joseph, and his sons, signifies completeness and covenant fulfillment.
- The growth of this small group of seventy into a mighty nation proves that God's sovereign purposes never fail.
- Believers can remain confident that God will faithfully bring all of His promises to final completion.
